(1) breast carcinoma treatment is more likely to be delivered by a surgical oncologist or a radiation oncologist in the community than in the academic setting, (2) breast carcinoma patients treated by surgical oncologists are more likely to receive adjuvant chemotherapy, (3) breast carcinoma patients with node‐negative disease are more likely to be treated with breast conservation, and (4) the use of breast conservation is more common in the academic than in the community setting.
